faq.title: Frequently asked questions about Secret Santa
faq.description: Arrow Secret Santa helps friends, families and coworkers organize a gift exchange. It is also known as Arrow Amigo Invisible in Spanish.

items.question: What is Secret Santa?
items.answer: Secret Santa is a gift exchange where each participant draws another person to give a gift to. Agree on a budget and exchange date, and keep your recipient a secret until the celebration.

items.question: How do I draw Secret Santa names by email?
items.answer: Add the names and email addresses of 3 to 30 participants. You can set a budget, date and exclusions. When you run the draw, Arrow Secret Santa emails each participant the name of their recipient.

items.question: Can I exclude couples or other pairs?
items.answer: Yes. Exclusions work in both directions, so the selected people cannot draw each other. Nobody draws their own name. If the exclusions make a draw impossible, remove a pair and try again.

items.question: Do I need an account or an in-person meeting?
items.answer: No account or group meeting is needed to run the draw. You only need the participants’ names and email addresses; each person receives their result by email.

items.question: Can I use it for friends, family or coworkers?
items.answer: Yes. Organize a Christmas Secret Santa or another gift exchange for 3 to 30 people. Agree on a gift budget and exchange date before drawing names.
